verdict.rationale: Fastmail has a help article titled "Calendar events and invitations", which suggests built-in calendar event and invite handling. The pack gives only that title, with no content showing how invites are answered or events created inside the mail client. A JMAP note that it replaces CalDAV is protocol-level only. Missing for 10: evidence of viewing the calendar alongside email, of responding to invites inline (accept/decline/RSVP), of creating events from within the mail client, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
